- When sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 5–10 days.  
- When sentiment is negative (≤0.33) or volatile, model often underestimates; add 1–3% to forecast for next 5–10 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > true by >5%), model often overcorrects; reduce forecast by 2–5% in next 3–7 days.  
- If true price deviates from 30-day moving average by >2%, model tends to lag; adjust forecast to align with 30-day MA for next 7–14 days.  
- If sentiment shifts from positive to negative (or vice versa) within 3–5 days, model fails to adjust; re-forecast with sentiment-weighted mean of last 7 days.
